content:
sam: main turned red right after merge of PR #4829 — smoke-gpu failing on step 'start-inference'. cc @maya @alex
ci-bot: CI failure: job=smoke-gpu build=build-2024-11-10-09:45 step=start-inference exited 1
maya: ack. did PR #4829 change any GPU runtime bits?
alex: it touched the batching logic in runtime/packaging.rs but only tiny change, looked fine in review
sam: it passed locally for me on a small run, flaky maybe. logs show K/V cache load error. past few runs on main look clean.
maya: can someone trigger a rerun for just the smoke-gpu job? if it flakes we can rerun and then bisect if it persists
triage-bot: suggested action: `rerun job` or `bisect between commits` — use cictl for targeted reruns.
sam: running: `cictl rerun --job smoke-gpu --build build-2024-11-10-09:45`
ci-bot: Rerun started: build=build-2024-11-10-09:50 (requested by sam)
alex: dropping a quick log snippet from failed run:
```
E1123 09:45:12.341 runtime.cpp:234] KVCache::load failed: file not found: /var/cache/rv_kv/params.bin
E1123 09:45:12.342 runtime.cpp:241] inference init failed: missing kv params
```
maya: that looks like a mount or prefetch ordering problem — if the cache init happens before the artifact download it fails. recent change in container entrypoint could affect ordering.
sam: PR touched entrypoint wrapper? no, but packaging change might change artifact path. maya, want me to roll back that part of PR to test?
maya: hold on rerun first. if rerun passes we mark as transient. if still fails we bisect.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: build=build-2024-11-10-09:50 status=FAILED (same step)
alex: same error on rerun — seems deterministic now.
maya: ok assigning owner: @alex please take the bisect. run `cictl bisect --job smoke-gpu --start 4825 --end 4829` to narrow it down.
alex: on it. starting bisect now. will update with step where it flips.
triage-bot: recommended next steps: 1) hold merges to main briefly 2) open follow-up issue if bisect points to packaging change 3) add flaky marker for smoke-gpu if it's unrelated to PRs
sam: adding hold on merges (policy: pause auto-merge for 15m).
maya: thanks. alex ping when you have the commit.
